description.value: Oakberry Açaí bowls is a Vancouver location of the global OAKBERRY franchise, serving customizable açaí bowls and smoothies on West 4th Avenue. The Canadian operation is run by Snowbank Brands and also offers a catering service including an OAKVAN mobile unit for events. It is a takeout-focused fast food stop with no drive-through.
